tweets.text: Thread: 7 growth tactics that actually worked for us going from 0 to 25K followers in 6 months
1/ Engage authentically with 50+ accounts in your niche daily. No copy-paste comments. Real value-add replies.
2/ Post consistently at the same times. Your audience develops habits around YOUR schedule.
3/ Create data-driven threads weekly. Numbers catch attention and build authority.
4/ Collaborate with accounts at a similar level. Quote tweet exchanges work wonders.
5/ Use lead magnets in tweets. 'Reply YES for the free guide' drives massive engagement.
6/ Repurpose your best-performing content every 30 days. New followers haven't seen it.
7/ Build in public. Share wins, losses, and lessons. Vulnerability creates connection.

tweets.text: Thread: How we built a $0 marketing engine that generates 500+ leads per month using only Twitter
Step 1: Create a content pillar strategy. We focus on 3 topics: growth marketing, founder stories, and data insights.
Step 2: Develop lead magnets for each pillar. Free templates, checklists, and mini-courses.
Step 3: Deploy keyword monitoring. When people ask about our topics, we add value (never pitch first).
Step 4: Nurture through DMs. Build real relationships, offer help, THEN share resources.
Step 5: Create landing pages for each lead magnet. Simple email capture with clear value prop.
Result: 500+ leads/month, 12% conversion to paying customers, $0 ad spend.

tweets.text: Thread: The exact framework we use to turn Twitter followers into email subscribers (step by step)
First, understand this: Twitter followers are rented. Email subscribers are owned. Build both.
Our funnel: Tweet -> Thread -> Lead Magnet -> Landing Page -> Email List -> Nurture -> Convert
Key insight: Your best tweets are lead magnet teasers. If a tweet performs well, there's demand for deeper content.
We convert at 15% from Twitter to email. Industry average is 2-3%. The difference? Relevance and timing.
